visual_logic.surface_detail: Glistening, semi-aquatic skin with deep terracotta and rusty orange patterns.
visual_logic.environment: Sluggish stream with thick clusters of Charophytes and giant Equisetites (horsetails).
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Single, continuous serpentine spine; needle-teeth visible in a long, slender snout; limbs are small, flat aquatic paddles.

pose: The slender body is stretched horizontally in a graceful 'S' shape across a Soft Terracotta mudbank, with the tip of the whip-like tail submerged in tea-colored water.
